intended_object: The docstring describes a "checked nominal proof certificate" called `alpha_dummy_073`. In practice it is a fresh bound-variable name. It is chosen to avoid the free variables of two specific syntactic class terms, so that an alpha-renaming step in a generated proof replay can be carried out.
explanation: The body applies `freshVar` to the union of the free-variable sets of two compact-syntax terms. It returns a variable that does not occur free in either term. This is an implementation detail of a machine-generated proof replay: a dummy variable used for alpha-conversion while building a formal derivation in an NF/choice development. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so faithfulness and generality do not apply to it.
